players.product: Copper surface-treatment / plating chemicals for package substrates (Samsung Electro-Mechanics supplier)

quarterly_data.signal: First half FY2026 (January-June 2026, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 12,594 million (+34.2%), of which chemicals JPY 12,402 million (+37.4%); operating income JPY 4,135 million (+69.4%), operating margin 32.8% versus 26.0% a year earlier; ordinary income JPY 4,305 million (+72.6%); profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 3,039 million (+60.5%). Management states sales set a new quarterly record high as demand for its chemicals for advanced semiconductor package substrates, mainly generative-AI related, stayed steady, and operating income rose sharply on higher chemical shipments and steady demand for high-margin products. Overseas sales ratio 66.0% (66.4% a year earlier); including sales to overseas customers through domestic Japanese agents, 82.0% (80.8%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 12,594 million (+34.2%); operating income JPY 4,135 million (+69.4%); operating margin 32.8%

quarterly_data.signal: Products and segments, first half FY2026 (semi-annual report): the CZ series ultra-roughening adhesion promoter, which holds a high share in semiconductor package substrates, performed strongly on demand for advanced package substrates (mainly generative-AI related) and memory package substrates; the V-Bond series and the EXE series (fine-line formation) rose with display and fine-wiring demand; the SF series declined. Segment sales: Japan JPY 4,563 million (+36.2%), segment profit JPY 3,354 million (+120.6%), with demand for advanced (generative-AI) package substrate products expanding and sales to Korea through Japanese agents firm on memory package substrate production; Taiwan JPY 2,328 million (+28.3%), led by advanced package substrates; Zhuhai (China) JPY 1,807 million (+44.7%) on memory package substrate demand; Suzhou (China) JPY 2,321 million (+34.3%) on generative-AI and data-center package substrates and display products; Europe JPY 768 million (-1.8%), as general-purpose board demand rose but the prior year's temporary materials demand did not recur; Thailand JPY 804 million (+74.9%) on satellite-communication and package-substrate demand as board makers invest and ramp in Southeast Asia. H1 R&D expenses JPY 736 million.
